newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ICI sells plastics film business to AEP.
newsitem.headline: ICI sells plastics film business to AEP.

text.p: ICI Australia Ltd said on Friday that it had reached agreement to sell its Visqueen polyethylene plastic film business in Sydney to AEP Industries (Australia) Pty Ltd, a unit of AEP Industries Inc.
Terms were not disclosed. ICI said the Sydney operation had annual sales of about A$25 million.
Completion of the sale was expected by the end of July.

The Visqueen operations located in the Sydney suburb of Chester Hill made industrial films such as pallet wrap and shrink wrap, with major customers in the brewery, soft drink and glass industries. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
